input.prompt: Clean flat vector infographic for a website, square composition on a pure white background, corporate flat-design style with soft rounded shapes, matching a light blue and yellow illustration set. Show a four-step document processing workflow arranged in a 2x2 grid of large rounded squares, connected in order by a thin dotted periwinkle-blue path with small arrow heads running top-left to top-right to bottom-right to bottom-left. Each square has a pale blue #E7F0FB fill, a big simple line-and-fill icon, a large blue circled step number (1, 2, 3, 4) in its top-left corner, and one short bold navy label beneath the icon in a clean sans-serif font. Step 1 icon: an inbox tray with an envelope and several paper documents (invoice, scanned page, phone photo) dropping in; label exactly 'Capture'. Step 2 icon: a document with a magnifying glass and highlighted fields turning into neat data rows with a small table grid; label exactly 'Extract'. Step 3 icon: a person at a screen comparing a document on the left and data fields on the right, with green check marks and one yellow warning flag; label exactly 'Validate'. Step 4 icon: a database cylinder connected to an ERP dashboard screen with a small bar chart and a blue check mark; label exactly 'Integrate'. In the exact center where the four squares meet, a small white circle badge with a document icon and a yellow spark. Palette: periwinkle blue #4A72D8, pale blue #C9DDF6, very light blue #E7F0FB, mustard yellow #F5B84A, navy #1F2A44, soft green check marks #3BB273, white. Generous margins, balanced spacing, crisp edges. The only text in the image is the four labels 'Capture', 'Extract', 'Validate', 'Integrate' and the four digits 1 2 3 4, all large, bold and perfectly spelled.
